visualLocks.face: Angular uncovered face, dark eyes and healed anatomical RIGHT cheek scar. No plague mask, helmet or hood.
visualLocks.hair: Short upswept black hair with a distinct white front forelock.
visualLocks.outfit: Long dark plum/black split coat, high collar, grey-purple metal shoulder/forearm/boot pieces, silver seams and magenta ragged inner hems; practical gloves, trousers and boots.
visualLocks.weapon: One red-coral crystalline fracture blade with pale/gold vein structure and irregular angular edges; no curved katana, skull cane, hammer or shield.
visualLocks.handedness: The reviewed written canon does not assign a unique weapon hand. Actual grips may vary with the gesture and are described per delivered CG; only the anatomical right-cheek scar is a fixed lateral identity mark.
visualLocks.lore: Seal hunter before A.R.C.A.; blade forged from cooled edges of three condemned portals; scar recalls the mistake involving a conscious double; refuses execution based on resemblance alone.
visualLocks.age: No established age in reviewed source; unknown-family-safe-only and no-romance.
